canonical_project: Project Mars Data Centre, 12 Mars Road Lane Cove West
notes: NSW Planning lists Project Mars Data Centre, SSD-82052708, at Response to Submissions stage for 24-hour operation of a data centre with about 90 MW power consumption. The pre-development application identifies 12 Mars Road, Lane Cove West and a 90 MVA load over two data centre buildings; public submissions identify Goodman Group as developer.
